calibration_intercept_decomposition.note: The reported intercept is the recalibration line at probability 0.5. The slope term is how much of it comes from the slope being multiplied by the distance from the operating point to that reading position. The remainder is the level error where the scores actually sit, and the prior move is how far the fraud rate travelled in the one period between calibration and scoring.

calibration_schedule.basis: The calibrator is fitted on the last closed period before scoring, then its level is corrected to a forecast of the scoring period's prior. The forecast rule is chosen by backtest on earlier periods only.
calibration_schedule.operating_control: Recalibrate at every period close, and raise a recalibration review when the observed prior moves more than 0.1 in logit from the calibration prior. This is an operating control, not a promotion gate.
calibration_schedule.selection_rule: lowest mean absolute one-period-ahead logit error on observed periods; a rule must beat carrying the last prior forward by more than 0.02 to be adopted, otherwise the simpler rule stands

governance_acceptance.feature_decision: housing_status is retained in the feature contract. Removing it was measured and costs 2.39 percentage points of catch at 5% capacity and 63 month-7 fraud cases, is a partial mitigation only, and closes the gap partly by levelling down.
limits: This acceptance is granted against the values in granted_against and lapses if any accepted metric worsens past the recorded tolerance.
It is matched reason by reason. A segment that begins failing later is not covered.
It resolves gate 5 only. The calibration intercept and the stability blocks fail independently and the challenger remains rejected.
It authorises no group-specific threshold and no automatic decline. Neither exists in the code or the schema.

BAF is synthetic account-opening data. Neither the disparity nor this acceptance transfers to a real portfolio, and a production version would need the same measurement on observed data plus legal review of the attribute.

reasoning.customer_age: Accepted as a prevalence artifact. The feature is audit-only and never trained on, and its review-rate ratio moves from 0.397 to 0.836, inside the 0.80 to 1.25 band, once each band's own fraud rate is accounted for.
reasoning.housing_status: Accepted on the business-justification record. The disparity is real and survives the prevalence adjustment at 0.484. Removal was measured rather than assumed: it costs 2.39 points of catch, brings the prevalence-adjusted ratio to 1.119 and the FPR gap under its trigger, and still leaves the raw ratio at 0.169 and the TPR gap at 0.190, so it does not close the check either. Group membership stays recoverable from the 32 remaining inputs at AUROC 0.799 and 0.770, so removal would remove the audit handle rather than the behaviour.

limitations: BAF is synthetic account-opening data and not observed loan-origination performance.
Economic values are assumptions rather than observed profit and loss.
The incumbent credit-risk score is a proxy and not a verified vendor product.
BAF has no cross-row identity or ring truth.
